critique: The luminous six-attractor particle cosmos convincingly becomes a “living loom” against ochre textile warps, turquoise terrace motifs, and slowly breathing concentric rings, creating a bold fusion of ancestral geometry and computational motion. The red wedges, CSS blades, black quadrilateral, dense borders, and tiny guinea-pig image compete as disconnected accents; letting particle trails visibly interlace with or transform the woven bands would strengthen hierarchy and make the cyber-textile concept feel fully integrated.
